title: NBA Trivia
description: From Wilt Chamberlain's 100-point game to the modern era — test your NBA knowledge.

questions.prompt: Who holds the NBA record for most points scored in a single game?
questions.explanation: Wilt Chamberlain scored 100 points for the Philadelphia Warriors against the New York Knicks on March 2, 1962.

questions.prompt: How many NBA championships did Michael Jordan win with the Chicago Bulls?
questions.explanation: Michael Jordan won 6 NBA championships with the Chicago Bulls in 1991, 1992, 1993, 1996, 1997, and 1998.

questions.prompt: Which team has won the most NBA championships in history?
questions.explanation: The Boston Celtics have won 17 NBA championships, tied with the Los Angeles Lakers as the most in NBA history.

questions.prompt: Who is the NBA's all-time leading scorer?
questions.explanation: LeBron James surpassed Kareem Abdul-Jabbar in February 2023 to become the NBA's all-time leading scorer.
Kobe Bryant coined the nickname 'Black Mamba' for himself, inspired by the deadly snake.

questions.prompt: In which year was the NBA founded?
questions.explanation: The NBA was founded on June 6, 1946, as the Basketball Association of America (BAA), before merging with the NBL in 1949 to form the NBA.

questions.prompt: Which team did LeBron James lead to a historic 3-1 Finals comeback in 2016?
questions.explanation: LeBron James led the Cleveland Cavaliers to overcome a 3-1 deficit against the Golden State Warriors in the 2016 NBA Finals.

questions.prompt: Who was the first player to win back-to-back MVP and Defensive Player of the Year awards in the same season?
questions.explanation: Hakeem Olajuwon won both the MVP and Defensive Player of the Year awards in 1993-94, a feat that has never been repeated.

questions.prompt: Stephen Curry plays his home games at which arena?
questions.explanation: The Golden State Warriors moved to Chase Center in San Francisco in 2019, leaving Oracle Arena in Oakland.

questions.prompt: Which player holds the record for most three-pointers made in a single NBA season?
questions.explanation: Stephen Curry set the record with 402 three-pointers in the 2015-16 season, breaking his own previous record.

questions.prompt: Which team drafted Kobe Bryant with the 13th overall pick in the 1996 NBA Draft?
questions.explanation: The Charlotte Hornets drafted Kobe Bryant 13th overall, then traded him to the Los Angeles Lakers for Vlade Divac.

questions.prompt: Who won the first ever NBA MVP award in 1956?
questions.explanation: Bob Pettit of the St. Louis Hawks won the inaugural NBA MVP award in 1956, the year the award was first given out.

questions.prompt: Which coach has the most NBA championship wins as a head coach?
questions.explanation: Phil Jackson won 11 NBA championships as a head coach — 6 with the Chicago Bulls and 5 with the Los Angeles Lakers.

questions.prompt: What is the diameter of an NBA regulation basketball hoop?
questions.explanation: An NBA regulation basketball hoop has an inner diameter of 18 inches (45.72 cm), which is just slightly larger than two basketballs.

questions.prompt: Which player scored 81 points in a single NBA game in 2006, the second-highest total ever?
questions.explanation: Kobe Bryant scored 81 points for the Los Angeles Lakers against the Toronto Raptors on January 22, 2006, the second-highest single-game total in NBA history.

questions.prompt: The 'Dream Team' that won gold at the 1992 Barcelona Olympics was the first US Olympic team to include NBA players. Who coached them?
questions.explanation: Chuck Daly, who had previously coached the Detroit Pistons to two championships, coached the legendary 1992 Dream Team to gold in Barcelona.

questions.prompt: Which NBA franchise was previously known as the Seattle SuperSonics?
questions.explanation: The Oklahoma City Thunder relocated from Seattle in 2008, where they had been the SuperSonics since 1967.
